mapping.summary: Allocates joint production costs across co-products and credits by-products at actual cost.
claims: Eight joint-cost allocation methods chosen per formula
By-products, scrap and waste are credited before the split
Versioned production formulas with effective dates and optional approval
Batch orders scale and adjust for potency and input scrap percentage
Posts through standard production orders with each output at its allocated cost
Batch close stores actual cost, cost and yield variances
Batch cannot close until all outputs pass quality release
Produces a certificate of analysis per batch
Yield, profitability, cost sheet and recall trace reports
Records CO2e for by-products, scrap and waste
Exposes APIs and queries for Power BI
Needs BC Premium online and the free Microsoft Quality Management app
Per-seat plans; users without a seat can view results
Free trial for the first month
